tables.name: cg_org_communication_sender
tables.rationale: an organization's outbound sender identity determines what identity messages carry org-wide — authority-adjacent configuration, never a client-consumable row set: the communication store reaches it exclusively through the service-role client (org-sender-store.server.ts) with Zod-validated reads and the deterministic pure resolver (org-sender-config.ts) doing precedence; zero policies + full client revoke keeps the deny-by-default strongest form — a policy accident would expose nothing because clients hold no privilege at all

tables.name: cg_api_key
tables.rationale: platform API keys are authority data (the same posture as cg_worker_delegation_grant: authority flows only through explicit grants) — the plaintext key is never stored (sha256 key_hash only), and issuance/verification/revocation run through the service-role apikey-service.server.ts which Zod-validates every row; publishable-key clients must never enumerate or mutate key rows, so zero policies + full anon/authenticated revoke is the strongest form
